title: Dawnsdrop Tools
text: *The Ollo Research Institute has reached a fascinating new discovery in their studies about the effects of various materials that are combined with Archeum. The study reveals that the effects seen were stronger with higher quality of materials, leading to unstable yet unique item properties. The research has reached several communities in Ynystere and Halcyona who have requested additional help from renowned gatherers to refine and test their understanding of this new discovery." Dawnsdrop tools are custom content for Archeage Classic. Tools are addition to the Dawnsdrop gear set that increases players proficiency and proficiency speed. While Dawnsdrop gear are upgradeable to give more certain proficiency so are the Dawnsdrop tools. For the tools the upgrading path means different kind of quests and use of the tool in certain amounts of labor. *The Ollo Research Institute has reached a fascinating new discovery in their studies about the effects of various materials that are combined with Archeum. The study reveals that the effects seen were stronger with higher quality of materials, leading to unstable yet unique item properties. The research has reached several communities in Ynystere and Halcyona who have requested additional help from renowned gatherers to refine and test their understanding of this new discovery."

Dawnsdrop tools are custom content for Archeage Classic. Tools are addition to the Dawnsdrop gear set that increases players proficiency and proficiency speed. While Dawnsdrop gear are upgradeable to give more certain proficiency so are the Dawnsdrop tools. For the tools the upgrading path means different kind of quests and use of the tool in certain amounts of labor.
